hire.title: Choose how to start
hire.description: Packages with a clear scope to get your idea off the ground or improve what already exists. Not sure which one? Start with the assessment or get in touch.
hire.note: Prices and timelines are confirmed in a written proposal after understanding your scenario.

faq.question: How does the work start?
faq.answer: After you reach out, we schedule a short call to understand the goal. Then I send a written proposal with scope, deliverables, timeline and price. Work starts after your approval.

faq.question: Are timelines guaranteed?
faq.answer: Package timelines are estimates. The final timeline goes in the proposal, once the scope is known, and is tracked through frequent deliveries you can see.

faq.question: How does payment work?
faq.answer: The payment method and schedule are defined in the proposal, according to the package and project size.

faq.question: I am not sure which package to choose. What now?
faq.answer: Start with the Technical Assessment or send me a message about what you need. I will suggest the best path, even if it is a different format from these packages.

faq.question: Do you work remotely?
faq.answer: Yes. I work remotely and, in São Paulo, also in a hybrid format when it makes sense for the project.

faq.question: Can I switch packages later?
faq.answer: Yes. It is common to start with the assessment or an MVP and then continue with consulting hours or monthly support.
